failure.body:
Docker 23.0.0 (1 Feb 2023) Release notes:

- Set Buildx and BuildKit as the default builder on Linux.
- The legacy builder can still be used by explicitly setting DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0.

Probably need to explicitly set DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 in slave.mk if SONIC_USE_DOCKER_BUILDKIT is disabled.

resolution.title: [Build] disable DOCKER_BUILDKIT if SONIC_USE_DOCKER_BUILDKIT is not set
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

Fix #14081
By default DOCKER_BUILDKIT is enabled after docker version 23.0.0
So we need to disable it explicitly if SONIC_USE_DOCKER_BUILDKIT is not set.
Otherwise it will produce larger installable images.

#### How I did it

set DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 in slave.mk
